label: Python with mypy (defaults)
description: Type checks Python components with mypy even without a mypy configuration: a component without one is checked with mypy's defaults (missing third-party stubs ignored); a component with mypy.ini, [tool.mypy] or [mypy] keeps its own configuration. Comes in by the Python language and runs only where typecheck is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available); it never turns the check on by itself. mypy is supplied by the project environment and is never installed during a run.
